scope: Isolated DOM/storage + actual 120 Hz solver; Canvas/Worker scheduling facades. No user archive was modified. No native 3D, GPU or frame-time claim.

checks.name: Live save failure persists past completion, append/import stay in session export, failed deletion retains old disk and selection
Procedure delete / controller save commit only after disk success; import/save/reload preserve ±360 / ±120 rate requests
Procedure result save failure remains independently visible after completed notification; raw live link and 120 Hz metrics are retained
Damaged procedure/results archives are isolated with exact original strings and new finished results cannot overwrite them
Standard research failed clear keeps report/selection/raw disk; quota and protected attempt logs are separate persistent states
Numeric challenge, saved editable graph, refresh, same-task re-decision, comparison, cancellation and EN editing share one usable UI
Live challenge uses the host fixed-step loop; pilot takeover releases authority and an invalid graph cannot start
Live low-pressure challenge keeps its real hard-landing failure, offers event telemetry and survives export/import/refresh
Challenge quota and quarantined original archives keep full new results and edited algorithms in session export with a persistent warning
